description: This file defines the GatewayMapper interface, which provides methods for mapping devices to their last gateway or a via gateway, including a static creation method. It includes package declarations, imports, interface documentation, and method signatures.

classes.name: GatewayMapper
classes.description: An interface for mapping devices to their last gateway or via gateway, with a factory method to create instances.

methods.name: create
methods.description: A static factory method to instantiate a GatewayMapper using default implementation, requiring factories and tracer as parameters.

methods.name: getMappedGatewayDevice
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the gateway device id for a given device, returning a Future that may resolve to the gateway id or the device id based on registration info.
